notes.title: Coming soon!
notes.notes: [p]Hey guys, how's it going?[/p][p]My name is Kayná Prestes, I'm a producer at FiveWinners Studios, and I'm really excited about the release of this game. I'm just stopping by to introduce myself and also to let you know that the game was supposed to be released today, but we're still being evaluated by Steam! I'll be bringing you updates soon, and we also have big plans for this month and next month, okay? [/p][p]I'm receiving your emails and will respond soon! Thank you for your support. See you later.[/p]
